name: api.backend
description: Backend/API surface gate: contracts, failure modes, idempotency, data safety.

typed_contract.instructions: Inputs and outputs are explicitly typed or schema-validated at the boundary

failure_path_defined.instructions: The failure path is defined: what happens on timeout, partial write, or downstream error

idempotent_or_justified.instructions: The operation is idempotent, or its non-idempotency is explicitly acknowledged and handled

unbounded_resource.instructions: The code can fan out, retry, or allocate without an explicit ceiling

destructive_unguarded.instructions: A destructive or irreversible operation runs without an explicitly passed target and a guard

rules.reason: destructive op without an explicit target -- an unset variable can land on real work
